title: Comparison of vertex and edge actions on marked simplicial sets
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories and equivalence edges of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and marked simplicial sets and coordinatewise product markings of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model]. Let $A$ be a small simplicial set, let $Y=(U,E_Y)$ and $X=(V,E_X)$ be small marked simplicial sets, and let $\mu:A^\sharp\times Y\to X$ be a marked simplicial map, where $A^\sharp$ marks every edge of $A$. Let $Z$ be any small quasicategory and $h:V\to Z$ a simplicial map taking $E_X$ to equivalences. For any edge $e:\Delta^1\to U$ and any edge $g:\Delta^1\to A$, put $g^*e=\mu\circ(g,e):\Delta^1\to V$. For a vertex $a\in A_0$, put $a^*e=\mu\circ(\operatorname{const}_a,e)$. Then $h(g^*e)$ is an equivalence in $Z$ if and only if $h(g(0)^*e)$ is an equivalence in $Z$. In particular, if $h(a^*e)$ is an equivalence for every vertex $a$ of $A$, then $h(g^*e)$ is an equivalence for every edge $g$ of $A$. No marking hypothesis is made on $e$, and no Kan hypothesis is made on $A,U$ or $V$.
